name: OrbitingWords
description: Spatial typography composition where satellite labels orbit a focal phrase with 3D perspective depth, counter-rotation legibility, and static layout mode.
a11yNotes: Renders a semantic list of orbiting terms for assistive technology and switches automatically to a clean radial static badge layout when mode='static' or prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

propsApi.name: centerPhrase
propsApi.description: Focal anchor phrase rendered at the center.

propsApi.name: words
propsApi.description: Satellite labels positioned along the orbital ring.

propsApi.name: mode
propsApi.description: Toggle continuous orbital rotation or fixed spatial layout.
